what: Each word of a section title stands up inside its own mask, tilted 5° (pivot bottom-left), from its own height below and transparent over .75s back (.025s stagger). When the section leaves the screen above 25% or below 75%, it fades out over 1s back, and re-entering stands it up again. Body lines ([data-fx-part=If line]) is present, each line stands up from 50% below at .1s intervals, trailing .25s behind

options.lag: Delay in seconds for body lines behind the title, default .25
options.ease: GSAP curve name, default back(= back.out(1.7))
options.start · end: Enter and exit positions, default top 75% · bottom 25%
options.once: If true, stops once and stays
options.[data-fx-part=head]: (If any) Heading whose words get split — if none, the element itself
options.[data-fx-part=line]: (If any) Body text that follows line by line

use:
A chapter headline

Body, one line

from.where: index.html·article.html section headings (.ow-content·.ow-insights__head·.ar-end), stat numbers (.ow-card__copy), photo stage text (data-slide-heading) — original motionHeadingFrom {yPercent 100, rotation 5, origin 0% 100%} → To {stagger .025, .75, back}, motionTextFrom {yPercent 50} → To {stagger .1, .75, back, delay .25}, motionDefaultExit {opacity 0, 1, back}, motionViewportBounds top 75% · bottom 25%

note: The original splits text with SplitText (type words, mask words) — here it’s done without SplitText, wrapping each word in an inline-block mask and leaving the spaces between as they are (Korean keep-all line breaks won’t break mid-word). For body text, instead of line splitting, the consuming side sets data-fx-part on each line (block).=Attach a line
